title: Peak lumbar flexion during maximal forward flexion

quantity.name: lumbar range of flexion
quantity.definition: mean of individual peak lumbar angles (T11-L1 line vs pelvic line)

source.authors: Pal P, Milosavljevic S, Sole G, Johnson G

how_to_use: Use 55.9 deg (SD 5.8) as end-of-range lumbar flexion for young males; hip (pelvis on femur) 69.2 deg.

measurement.device: 12-camera Motion Analysis system, 60 Hz; markers T12, L3, ASIS, PSIS, greater trochanter, lateral femoral epicondyle, 1/3 thigh
measurement.posture: standing, feet 1/10 body height apart, knees straight
measurement.task: 5 trials of maximal forward flexion, hold 2 counts, return to upright, self-paced within 10 s; time normalised to 100 points

protocol.notes: Same value also in kinematics.pal2007.lumbar_hip_timecourse (do not double count).

pass_rule.rule: input data – not graded; use for robustness checks
